resources.string: Show actual SoundCloud track cards within Capsule search. Requires an authorized SoundCloud API access token; playback in Capsule is not yet connected.
Find and play on SoundCloud (web preview)
SoundCloud • experimental web player. These are SoundCloud’s own results, not YouTube matches. Playback stays on SoundCloud’s website and is not added to Capsule’s queue.
Not set: SoundCloud search cannot load tracks
Set: expires periodically; change or clear here

Test only. Enter an OAuth access token issued to your own authorized SoundCloud API application. Do not enter your password, client secret or somebody else\'s token. This token is stored in app preferences and expires; do not use the feature on shared devices.
To see actual SoundCloud results, configure an authorized SoundCloud API token in Settings → Content.
SoundCloud authorization is expired or denied. Update your API access token in Settings.
SoundCloud search is temporarily rate-limited. Try again later.
SoundCloud search is currently unavailable. Check the connection and API access.
SoundCloud search results are native. Playback inside Capsule is not connected yet.
